response.rationale: Yes, most likely, though I'm only moderately confident. Both A ("Session booking and checkout") and B ("Member session booking") describe booking sessions. Both are anchored on the same class, BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180), which 12 other classes depend on. A comes from community:0, a cluster built around BookingService, and adds checkout. B comes from component:persistence, a technical layer that also holds unrelated clients and repositories (DropTextClient, PuckPayClient, HireStockRepository). In B, only BookingRepository and probably SessionRepository relate to booking. So B looks like a narrower, persistence-side view of the same booking capability rather than a different one. The checkout part of A, and the fact that B's grouping is technical rather than business, are why I'm not more confident.
